import os, re

# Build a per-file function map: which functions contain plain spin_lock
# and which functions are registered as timer callbacks.
timer_reg = re.compile(r'(?:timer_setup|setup_timer)\s*\(\s*[^,]+,\s*([a-zA-Z_0-9]+)')
define_timer = re.compile(r'DEFINE_TIMER\s*\(\s*[a-zA-Z_0-9]+\s*,\s*([a-zA-Z_0-9]+)')
# .function = foo  (older kernels) / hrtimer .function assignments
fn_assign = re.compile(r'\.function\s*=\s*([a-zA-Z_0-9]+)')

def func_ranges(src):
    # simple brace matcher over function definitions
    lines = src.split('\n')
    funcs = []
    funcdef = re.compile(r'^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z_0-9 \*\t]*\s+\**([a-zA-Z_0-9]+)\s*\([^;]*\)\s*$')
    i = 0
    n = len(lines)
    while i < n:
        m = funcdef.match(lines[i])
        if m:
            name = m.group(1)
            # find opening brace
            j = i
            depth = 0
            started = False
            while j < n:
                for ch in lines[j]:
                    if ch == '{':
                        depth += 1
                        started = True
                    elif ch == '}':
                        depth -= 1
                if started and depth == 0:
                    break
                j += 1
            funcs.append((name, i+1, j+1))  # 1-based line numbers
            i = j + 1
        else:
            i += 1
    return funcs

plain_lock = re.compile(r'\bspin_lock\s*\(')
bh_lock = re.compile(r'\bspin_lock_bh\s*\(|local_bh_disable')

candidates = []
roots = ['drivers', 'net', 'kernel', 'fs', 'mm', 'block', 'security', 'ipc', 'lib']
for root in roots:
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        for fn in filenames:
            if not fn.endswith('.c'):
                continue
            p = os.path.join(dirpath, fn)
            try:
                with open(p, errors='ignore') as f:
                    src = f.read()
            except Exception:
                continue
            cbnames = set(timer_reg.findall(src)) | set(define_timer.findall(src)) | set(fn_assign.findall(src))
            if not cbnames:
                continue
            funcs = func_ranges(src)
            for name, start, end in funcs:
                if name in cbnames:
                    body = '\n'.join(src.split('\n')[start-1:end])
                    has_plain = plain_lock.search(body)
                    has_bh = bh_lock.search(body)
                    if has_plain and not has_bh:
                        candidates.append((p, name, start, end))

    print(f"{p}:{start}-{end} {name}")
print(f"TOTAL: {len(candidates)}")
EOF
